issues.where: crop U lower-center photosphere (x≈1085, y≈866–1080), also in image-02.png crop G, image-01.png, image-08.png crop U, image-06.png crop G, and image-05.png
issues.what: a vertical mirrored-UV seam runs through the foreground photosphere, creating butterfly-symmetric granules, paired twin bright dots, and a 4-way kaleidoscope cross
issues.fix: replace mirrored UV repeat on the granulation texture with seamless 3D procedural convection or stochastic non-mirroring tile blending

issues.where: bottom 10–12 pixels across crops S, T, U, V, and W (y≈1068–1080), also in image-02.png crops F and G and bottom edge of image-01.png
issues.what: a horizontal mirror-reflection seam folds every granule and dark intergranular lane symmetrically back on itself along the bottom edge of the frame
issues.fix: remove latitudinal ping-pong UV wrapping and extend seamless spherical photosphere coverage well beyond the bottom camera frustum

issues.where: crop A just right of the left coronal-loop footpoint above the limb (x≈780–960, y≈445–485), also in image-07.png crop P and image-05.png
issues.what: the chromospheric haze terminates along a flat horizontal patch edge with dark vertical streak and silhouette artifacts sitting over the bright limb glow
issues.fix: expand or remove the rectangular billboard/patch bounds on the prominence/spicule layer and fix alpha/additive compositing so dark streaks cannot cut into the horizon glow

issues.where: outer coronal loop arches in crops F (912,0,456,433) and C (1212,54,456,433), and thin strands in image-02.png crops A, C, and H
issues.what: the upper loop arch has sharp, aliased polygon-ribbon borders clipping internal diagonal hatching, while thinner strands show 1-pixel stair-stepping, beaded breaks, and identical repeated S-curve wiggles
issues.fix: render coronal loops with soft transverse volumetric falloff and higher anti-aliased curve subdivision, and randomize per-strand perturbation phase

issues.where: sunspot umbra, penumbra, and nearby loop base in crop A (732,324,456,433), also in image-03.png crop P, image-06.png crop A, and image-07.png crops P and Q
issues.what: radial UV pinching smears outer penumbral granules into plastic streaks while the inner umbral rim breaks into jagged 1-pixel bright speckles around a flat pure-black cutout, with blocky horizontal pixel noise at the adjacent loop footpoint
issues.fix: synthesize dedicated high-resolution radial penumbral fibrils and subtle umbral detail with anti-aliased transitions instead of radial texture warping and black clamping, and raise shader/buffer resolution at the bright footpoint

issues.where: sky background in crop A upper half and starfield/Milky Way in image-03.png and image-07.png crops J, K, and L
issues.what: the Milky Way background plate shows coarse 4–8 px blocky upscaling/compression artifacts where boosted by coronal glow, and stars appear as soft multi-pixel blobs shining straight through bright coronal ribbons and limb haze
issues.fix: use an uncompressed native-resolution sky plate (or realistically suppress faint stars/nebulae against direct solar exposure) and mask/attenuate background stars behind bright prominences and coronal glare

issues.where: near-field photosphere across crops S, T, U, V, and W (and image-08.png crops S–W, image-02.png and image-06.png crops D, F, and G)
issues.what: foreground granules look soft and over-magnified with fibrous directional smearing, diagonal stretching toward the lower corners, and clipped white spots that resemble shiny plastic highlights
issues.fix: add crisp high-frequency procedural sub-granular detail in the near field, reduce perspective UV stretching at frame corners, and use smooth emissive blackbody roll-off without specular-like hotspots

issues.where: upper limb atmospheric glow in crop N (0,433,456,433) and image-02.png / image-06.png crop I
issues.what: a faint dark concentric band produces a subtle doubled-halo step between the spicule fringe and the outer coronal falloff
issues.fix: unify the chromospheric and coronal radial falloff curves in floating-point with dithering so brightness decays smoothly into space

issues.where: near and middle of the granule field, confirmed in image-10.png tiles D, E, and G and image-12.png tiles S through U
issues.what: cells read as glossy amber resin, with oily specular crests and dark lanes like molded plastic rather than plasma
issues.fix: drop the glassy highlight shader and rebuild the cells as emissive, high-frequency convection with dark lanes and no specular skin

issues.where: disk center and active regions, native in image-14.png tile A and image-15.png tiles L, P, and Q
issues.what: the bright surface is one continuous fibrous swirl, airbrushed curl noise instead of cellular granulation, and the vortices share the same pinwheel grammar
issues.fix: break the swirl into varied convective cells with irregular dark lanes, and stop stamping the same vortex into each active region

issues.where: sunspot center and inner penumbra, native in image-10.png tiles A and G and image-11.png tile P
issues.what: fibrils pinch radially into a flat, featureless black void
issues.fix: keep structure inside the umbra and ease the radial pinch so the fibers do not meet at a single sink

issues.where: lower-right foreground, tiles V and W
issues.what: granules are smeared on a diagonal, a mapping stretch rather than limb foreshortening
issues.fix: remove the diagonal texture stretch and keep cell shapes intact except where the limb truly foreshortens them

issues.where: far left limb tile N and far right limb tile R
issues.what: spicules and far granules go soft and airbrushed while the foreground stays sharp
issues.fix: hold granule and spicule frequency out to the limb instead of blurring the horizon into a fur fringe

issues.where: upper-left limb tile K and right limb tile R, also the fading rays in image-16.png
issues.what: the disk stays a hard line under the corona, and the outer rays show slight radial banding as they fade
issues.fix: widen and soften the limb falloff, and dither the ray fade so the glow does not step into the sky

issues.where: loop strands in tiles C and H, and the flare footpoint in image-11.png tile O
issues.what: strands read as hard luminous wires, and the footpoints clip to flat white
issues.fix: scatter and thicken the strands into a soft volume, and roll off the footpoint exposure so it does not clip

issues.where: crops A and F, around the dark cores and bright active regions
issues.what: Multiple dark cores have the same tightly wound pinwheel structure, and the surrounding plasma forms long, glossy ribbons. The repeated shape makes the surface look sculpted rather than granular.
issues.fix: Vary the shape and flow of each active region, break up the long ribbons, and retain fine, irregular granulation between filaments.

issues.where: crops U and V, immediately outside the lower limb
issues.what: The fine surface texture ends at a narrow orange outline, while the corona begins as a bank of soft straight streaks. The abrupt change in sharpness makes the corona look like a separate layer behind the disk.
issues.fix: Break up the continuous rim with irregular fine structures and mix shorter, sharper filaments into the diffuse coronal glow at its base.

issues.where: corona above and below the disk
issues.what: At full-frame scale, much of the corona reads as long, similarly soft radial rays, giving it the look of a zoom blur.
issues.fix: Vary the ray widths, lengths and falloffs, and deepen the spaces between the strongest streamers.

issues.where: crop O, star field around the blue-brown dust lane
issues.what: Some of the brighter stars spread into soft colored dots without distinct bright cores.
issues.fix: Keep compact cores on the brighter stars and reserve wider bloom for the few highest-intensity points.
